performance.verdict: Spend is intentionally throttled; 7 leads in 28 days signals intake capacity, not ad failure.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue: intake owner unconfirmed (blocks scale-up gate), booking bot, Review Boost, financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating re-enable — all past due by Aug–Sep 1.

28-day CPL is $232.05 on only 7 leads; 3-day spend (Sep 11–13: $44.69+$32.79+$32.29=$109.77) vs prior 3 (Sep 8–10: $47.59+$71.73+$40.79=$160.11) shows spend falling 31% with leads at 1 in 6 days — volume too thin to judge efficiency.
Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP: 206 impressions over 25 days, 0 calls, 0 directions, 0% call rate — profile is generating no leads despite visible organic exposure.

GHL shows 680 opportunities created vs only 45 won and 267 contacts; with Vivian (dispatch) gone since 7/7, speed-to-lead automation points at an unconfirmed seat — intake leak probable, not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped 54.55% week-over-week; last 2 days of series show 0 actions each (Sep 12–13), consistent with Windsor data lag flagged in SOW — not confirmed degradation yet.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login immediately; 680 opps created, 45 won — speed-to-lead seat may be empty since 7/7.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left dispatch on 7/7 and the intake owner seat is unconfirmed as of 2026-09-14; GHL shows 680 opportunities created against only 45 won, suggesting leads are arriving but not being worked. Action: confirm who owns intake, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is live. Success check: named intake owner with verified GHL access confirmed by 2026-09-17; this must be cleared before any budget scale-up is approved per the SOW gate.

suggestions.text: Optimize Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP profile — 206 impressions, 0 calls; add call button, correct category, and post CTA.
suggestions.monday_update: The Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP profile generated 206 impressions over 25 days with zero calls and a 0% call rate, while the Quality HVAC Solutions profile achieved a 2.4% call rate on 1,085 impressions. Action: audit the Fibid profile for missing or incorrect primary category, add/verify the call button, and publish at least one keyword-relevant post with a direct call CTA. Success check: call rate above 0% and at least 2 calls recorded within the next 14 days; re-check 2026-09-28.
